historical_observation: W2 was the first recorded non-finite stage under the rejected FP16-cache/fixed-order-FP32 diagnostic path.

identified_fault.fault: normal binary16 exponent was treated as an unbiased exponent before adding binary32 bias
identified_fault.effect: every normal FP16 value was decoded with exponent 15 too large, a factor of 32768
identified_fault.corrected_by: subtract binary16 bias 15 before applying binary32 bias 127
identified_fault.coverage: scalar normal/subnormal cases, exhaustive 63,488 finite binary16 patterns against an independent reference, and all 13 real cached tensors

corrected_full_path.policy: FP16 cache expanded to FP32; fixed-order FP32 reduction; corrected decoder
corrected_full_path.conclusion: The historical W2 non-finite disappears completely under corrected decode.

o7_selected_complete_reduction.conclusion: No selected W2 product or partial-sum overflow remains after corrected decode.
